<DESCRIPTION>EXHIBIT 4.1

<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: right"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: right"><B>Exhibit&nbsp;4.1</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>ANGEL OAK RESIDENTIAL EVERGREEN TRUST</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">Form&nbsp;of Distribution Reinvestment Plan</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">Effective [<FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT>],
2026</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Angel Oak Residential Evergreen
Trust, a Maryland statutory trust (the &ldquo;<B>Company</B>&rdquo;), hereby adopts the following plan (the &ldquo;<B>Plan</B>&rdquo;)
with respect to cash distributions declared by its board of trustees on the Company&rsquo;s common shares, par value $0.01 per share (&ldquo;<B>Common
Shares</B>&rdquo;), which are designated as Series&nbsp;A-I common shares (&ldquo;<B>Series&nbsp;A-I shares</B>&rdquo;), Series&nbsp;A-II
common shares (&ldquo;<B>Series&nbsp;A-II shares</B>&rdquo;) and Series&nbsp;B common shares (&ldquo;<B>Series&nbsp;B shares</B>&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">1.<B><I>&nbsp;Distribution Reinvestment.&nbsp;</I></B>As
agent for the shareholders (the &ldquo;<B>Shareholders</B>&rdquo;) of the Company who (i)&nbsp;purchase Series&nbsp;A-I shares, Series&nbsp;A-II
shares and Series&nbsp;B shares (collectively the &ldquo;<B>Shares</B>&rdquo;) pursuant to the Company&rsquo;s continuous private offering
(the &ldquo;<B>Offering</B>&rdquo;) or (ii)&nbsp;purchase Shares pursuant to any future offering of the Company (a &ldquo;<B>Future Offering</B>&rdquo;),
and who do not opt out of participating in the Plan (the &ldquo;<B>Common Share Participants</B>&rdquo;), the Company will apply all dividends
and other distributions declared and paid in respect of the Shares held by each Common Share Participant and attributable to the series
of Shares purchased by such Comon Share Participants (the &ldquo;<B>Common Share Distributions</B>&rdquo;), including Common Share Distributions
paid with respect to any full or fractional Shares acquired under the Plan, to the purchase of additional Shares of the same series for
such Common Share Participants.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In addition, as agent for the holders of units
(the &ldquo;<B>OP Units</B>&rdquo;) of Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Operating Partnership L.P., a Delaware limited partnership (the
&ldquo;<B>Operating Partnership</B>&rdquo;), other than the Company or its affiliates and who opt in to participating in the Plan (together
with the participating Shareholders, the &ldquo;<B>Participants</B>&rdquo;), the Operating Partnership will apply all distributions declared
and paid in respect of the OP Units held by each Participant (together with the Common Share Distributions, the &ldquo;<B>Distributions</B>&rdquo;),
including Distributions paid with respect to any full or fractional OP Units, to the purchase of Shares for such Participant having the
same class or series designation as the applicable series of OP Units to which such Distributions are attributable.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">2.&nbsp;<B><I>Effective Date.&nbsp;</I></B>The
effective date of this Plan shall be the date that the Company conducts an Initial Closing of the Offering and commences operations as
described in the Company&rsquo;s private placement memorandum, as amended and/or supplemented from time to time (the &ldquo;<B>PPM</B>&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">3.&nbsp;<B><I>Procedure for Participation.&nbsp;</I></B>Any
Shareholder will automatically become a Participant unless they elect not to become a Participant by noting such election on their subscription
agreement, and any holder of OP Units will become a Participant by noting their election to become a Participant on their subscription
agreement. Any Shareholder who is a client of a participating broker-dealer that does not permit automatic enrollment in the Plan will
become a Participant if they elect to become a Participant by noting such election on their subscription agreement. If any Shareholder
or holder of OP Units initially elects not to be a Participant, they may later become a Participant by subsequently completing and executing
an enrollment form or any appropriate authorization form as may be available from the Company, the Company&rsquo;s transfer agent, the
intermediary manager for the Offering or any soliciting dealer participating in the distribution of Shares or OP Units for the Offering.
Participation in the Plan will begin with the next Distribution payable after acceptance of a Participant&rsquo;s subscription, enrollment
or authorization. Shares will be purchased under the Plan on the date that Distributions are paid by the Company.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">4.&nbsp;<B><I>Suitability.&nbsp;</I></B>Each Participant
is requested to promptly notify their participating broker-dealer in writing if the Participant experiences a material change in his or
her financial condition, including the failure to meet status as an &ldquo;accredited investor&rdquo; as defined by Regulation D of the
Securities Act of 1933 (the &ldquo;<B>Securities Act</B>&rdquo;) or other investment standards imposed by the Company and set forth in
the Company&rsquo;s most recent offering documents. For the avoidance of doubt, this request in no way shifts to the Participant the responsibility
of the Company&rsquo;s sponsor, the participating broker-dealer or any other person selling shares on behalf of the Company to the Participant
to make every reasonable effort to determine that the purchase of Shares is a suitable and appropriate investment based on information
provided by such Participant.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">5.&nbsp;<B><I>Purchase of Shares.</I></B> Participants
will acquire Shares from the Company (including Shares purchased by the Company for the Plan in a secondary market (if available) or on
a stock exchange (if listed)) under the Plan (the &ldquo;<B>Plan Shares</B>&rdquo;) at a price equal to the NAV per Share applicable to
the series of Shares purchased by the Participant on the date that the distribution is payable (calculated using the most recently determined
monthly NAV ). The most recently determined monthly NAV is generally based on our NAV as of the last calendar day of the month that is
2 months (approximately 60 days) prior to the distribution. No upfront selling commissions will be payable with respect to shares purchased
pursuant to the Plan. Any annual shareholder servicing fees with respect to our shares are calculated based on our NAV for those shares
and may reduce the NAV or, alternatively, the distributions payable with respect to shares of such series, including shares issued in
respect of distributions on such shares under the distribution reinvestment plan. In addition, any series specific management fees, intermediary
manager fees or accruals/allocations of the performance participation interest may also reduce the NAV, or alternatively, the distributions
payable with respect to shares of a series, including shares issued in respect of distributions on such shares under the distribution
reinvestment plan. Participants in the Plan may purchase fractional Shares so that 100% of the Distributions will be used to acquire Shares.
However, a Participant will not be able to acquire Plan Shares and such Participant&rsquo;s participation in the Plan will be terminated
to the extent that a reinvestment of such Participant&rsquo;s distributions in Shares would cause the percentage ownership or other limitations
contained in the Company&rsquo;s Declaration of Trust to be violated.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">6.&nbsp;<B><I>Taxes.&nbsp;</I></B>THE REINVESTMENT
OF DISTRIBUTIONS DOES NOT RELIEVE A PARTICIPANT OF ANY INCOME TAX LIABILITY THAT MAY&nbsp;BE PAYABLE ON THE DISTRIBUTIONS. INFORMATION
REGARDING POTENTIAL TAX INCOME LIABILITY OF PARTICIPANTS MAY&nbsp;BE FOUND IN THE PUBLIC FILINGS MADE BY THE COMPANY WITH THE SEC.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">7.&nbsp;<B><I>Share Certificates.&nbsp;</I></B>The
ownership of the Shares purchased through the Plan will be in book-entry form unless and until the Company issues certificates for its
outstanding Shares.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">8.&nbsp;<B><I>Reports.&nbsp;</I></B>On a quarterly
basis, the Company shall provide each Participant a statement of account describing, as to such Participant: (i)&nbsp;the Distributions
reinvested during the quarter; (ii)&nbsp;the number and series of Shares purchased pursuant to the Plan during the quarter; (iii)&nbsp;the
per-share purchase price for such Shares; and (iv)&nbsp;the total number of Shares purchased on behalf of the Participant under the Plan.
On an annual basis, tax information with respect to income earned on Shares under the Plan for the calendar year will be provided to each
applicable participant.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">9.&nbsp;<B><I>Termination by Participant.&nbsp;</I></B>A
Participant may terminate participation in the Plan at any time, without penalty, by delivering 10 days&rsquo; prior written notice to
the Company. This notice must be received by the Company prior to the last day of a quarter in order for a Participant&rsquo;s termination
to be effective for such quarter (i.e., a timely termination notice will be effective as of the last day of a quarter in which it is timely
received and will not affect participation in the Plan for any prior quarter). Any transfer of Shares or OP Units by a Participant to
a&nbsp;non-Participant&nbsp;will terminate participation in the Plan with respect to the transferred Shares or OP Units. If a Participant
requests that the Company repurchase all or any portion of the Participant&rsquo;s Shares or OP Units, the Participant&rsquo;s participation
in the Plan with respect to the Participant&rsquo;s Shares or OP Units for which repurchase was requested but that were not repurchased
will be terminated. If a Participant terminates Plan participation, the Company may, at its option, ensure that the terminating Participant&rsquo;s
account will reflect the whole number of shares in such Participant&rsquo;s account and provide a check for the cash value of any fractional
share in such account. Upon termination of Plan participation for any reason, future Distributions will be distributed to the Shareholder
or holder of OP Units in cash.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">10.&nbsp;<B><I>Amendment, Suspension or Termination
by the Company.&nbsp;</I></B>The Board of Trustees may by majority vote amend any aspect of the Plan; provided, that the Plan cannot be
amended to eliminate a Participant&rsquo;s right to terminate participation in the Plan and that notice of any material amendment must
be provided to Participants at least 10 days prior to the effective date of that amendment. The Board of Trustees may by majority vote
suspend or terminate the Plan for any reason upon 10 days&rsquo; written notice to the Participants.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">11.&nbsp;<B><I>Liability of the Company.&nbsp;</I></B>The
Company shall not be liable for any act done in good faith, or for any good faith omission to act, including, without limitation, any
claims or liability (i)&nbsp;arising out of failure to terminate a Participant&rsquo;s account upon such Participant&rsquo;s death prior
to timely receipt of notice in writing of such death or (ii)&nbsp;with respect to the time and the prices at which Shares are purchased
or sold for a Participant&rsquo;s account. To the extent that indemnification may apply to liabilities arising under the Securities Act,
or the securities laws of a particular state, the Company has been advised that, in the opinion of the SEC and certain state securities
commissioners, such indemnification is contrary to public policy and, therefore, unenforceable.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>
